warnings: FIVE JOINT DETAILS for the precast SOLID PLANK (SP) floor system that S-03 and S-04 tag across most of the framed floors, plus one detail for the cast-in-place S slab. This is the sheet that says HOW the SP planks land.

THE GOVERNING RULE IS THE BEARING MINIMUM: 'ระยะไม่น้อยกว่า 0.05 ม.' -- each plank end must seat at least 50 mm on its support. It is printed three times on the first detail and once on each of the next two. It is a MINIMUM, not a set-out dimension, and is recorded as bearing.min_m.
TOPPING IS 0.05 M EVERYWHERE on this sheet, matching S-01 item 4 (SOLID PLANK 5 cm + 5 cm topping).

EXTRA TOPPING STEEL ('เสริมพิเศษ') RUNS 0.70 M EACH SIDE of a plank joint, at Ø6@0.20. Where the joint is with a cast-in-place S slab or a bathroom step the tie bars step up from 1+1Ø6 to 1+1Ø9 and the S slab's own Ø9@0.20 continues through.

BEAM DEPTH AT THE JOINT VARIES BY CASE: 0.30 m for the plain interior joint, 0.40 m for the S-slab, bathroom and raised-slab cases. The details are drawn for a given depth, so pairing the wrong detail with a beam mark from S-12 will give the wrong bar lengths.
THE BATHROOM DETAIL IS THE ONLY ONE WITH A LEVEL CHANGE: 0.10 m down to ระดับพื้นห้องน้ำ. Nothing else distinguishes it from the SP-to-S detail.

The edge-beam detail ('บริเวณริมคาน') is tagged with the TOPPING and 0.05 only -- no bearing figure, no reinforcement, no beam depth. Flagged no_reinforcement_tagged rather than filled in from the neighbouring details.
